mechanism_narrative: A higher level of CPIAUCSL (Consumer Price Index) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real earnings and increases risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 190, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in housing starts (HOUST) indicate a deteriorating labor market and weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term of UNRATE and HOUST does not yield a negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction holds in less than 40% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 195), the S&P 500 exhibits negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of HOUST (Housing Starts) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong housing activity signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where HOUST is above 2000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of INDPRO (Industrial Production) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong industrial output indicates robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO is above 120, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term of HOUST and INDPRO does not yield a negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction holds in less than 40% of interaction events.
